_note: The Round 3 scenario from 'Vantari — Round 3 Simulation Plan'. Lakshmi, Arun and the facts about her come from the plan; the sister's name, the doctor, clinics, chemists, lab, phone numbers and the medicine are fictional fill-ins chosen by the team and can be changed here. No real person, clinic or registration number. Nothing in the code may depend on these specific values. After editing, run `npm run gen:media` to rebuild the seeded records.

call_chain._note: Ranked by Arun at signup for ability to make a sound decision, not by age.

consent._note: Each adult consents to what is shared and with whom. Stage 0.

current_medicines.name: Metoprolol
current_medicines.schedule: one tablet morning, one at night

red_flags._note: Set with the family doctor at onboarding. The agent matches spoken symptoms against this list. It never names a condition. Giddiness on standing is deliberately not on it: urgent, not an emergency.
list: fainting, or a fall she cannot get up from
slurred speech, a drooping face or weakness on one side
a sudden severe headache with blurred vision

wallet._note: Set by Arun at signup. A month of tablets (60 at about ₹4) is above the ask-first amount, so a full refill comes to him first.

wait_times_seconds._note: Proposed in the brief, kept configurable. How long the agent waits for an answer before moving down the call chain.

sim_clock._note: The Director advances this only to dates the agent's own data produced. Tuesday, 9:12am: the voice note in the plan.
